Line 2 .  Net gain or (loss) shown on California Schedule(s) K-1 (100S, 541, 565, and 568) .   (d). Loss.
Line 2.    (e) Gain.
Line 3 .  Capital gain distributions (federal Form 1099-DIV, box 2 a ) .
Line 4 . Total 2025 gains from all sources. Add column (e) amounts of line 1, line 2, and line 3.
Line 5 . 2025 loss. Add column (d) amounts of line 1 and line 2.
Line 6 . California capital loss carryover from 2024, if any. See instructions.
Line 7 . Total 2025 loss. Add line 5 and line 6.
Line 8 . Net gain or (loss). Combine line 4 and line 7. If a loss, go to line 9. If a gain, go to line 10.
Line 9 . If line 8 is a loss, enter the smaller of: a. the loss on line 8. b. $3,000 ($1,500 if married/registered domestic partner filing separate). See instructions.
Line 10 . Enter the gain or (loss) from federal Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 7a.
Line 11 . Enter the California gain from line 8 or (loss) from line 9.
Line 12 a . If line 10 is more than line 11, enter the difference here and on Schedule CA (540), Part I, Section A, line 7a, column B.
Line 12 b . If line 10 is less than line 11, enter the difference here and on Schedule CA (540), Part I, Section A, line 7a, column C.
